about: arbeidsplassen.nav.no is NAV's Norwegian public job board. This CLI searches job ads with filters, sorting and paging, opens individual ads, and reads a few informational pages. The site is server-rendered, so most commands parse HTML.

commands.summary: Search job ads (ledige stillinger) by keyword, with filters for county, publish date, category, extent, remote work, sector, experience and under-18, plus sorting and paging (25 results per page)

params.name: q
params.description: Free-text keyword (place, occupation or search term), e.g. 'utvikler'

params.name: county
params.description: County (fylke) in upper case, e.g. OSLO, ROGALAND, VESTLAND. Only one value per call has been tested.

params.name: published
params.description: Publish-date window: 'now/d' = published today, 'now-7d' = last 7 days

params.name: remote
params.description: Remote-work option, e.g. 'Hybridkontor' (seen in a recorded URL) or 'Hjemmekontor'

params.name: experience
params.description: Experience requirement, e.g. 'ingen krav til arbeidserfaring' (no experience required)

params.name: under18
params.description: Set true to show only jobs open to applicants under 18

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order. Omit for most relevant; 'published' = newest first; 'expires' = soonest application deadline first

params.name: from
params.description: Result offset, in steps of 25 (0 = page 1, 25 = page 2, ...)

commands.summary: Get one job ad by its UUID: title, employer, location, employment details, application deadline, apply link and full description

params.name: id
params.description: Job ad UUID (the last path segment of the url returned by search-jobs)

commands.summary: Check whether the current session is logged in to arbeidsplassen.no (returns ok and isAuthenticated)
List the youth landing-page shortcuts (/ung), such as jobs for under-18s and jobs that need no experience, with their search URLs
Read NAV's info page about the job-ad import API (how employers and vendors can publish ads to arbeidsplassen.no)
